android-crash-report.description: Find why an Android app crashed or froze from a logcat or bugreport, then write it up as a report or blog post

steps.purpose: Analyse the log and list crashes, ANRs and likely causes
Turn the findings into a clear bug report or blog post and check it

android-ui-test-suite.description: Capture an Android screen, build locators, then write and verify Kotlin tests that use them

steps.purpose: Dump the screen and generate keyword to resource-id locators
Write and run tests for the page objects built on those locators, then check test quality

screen-recording-bug-report.description: Analyse a screen recording of a bug (freezes, black frames, colour changes) and write the bug report

steps.purpose: Extract timeline, frozen or black sections and key frames
Inspect the key frames: colours, text, differences
Write the bug report with evidence and reproduction steps

repo-to-blog.description: Read a repository to learn how it works, then write a blog post or technical document about it

steps.purpose: Read the whole repository and write LEARNINGS.md
Draft the post from the learnings, with accurate details, then check it

docs-to-skill.description: Turn a web documentation page into a skill and add it to the hub
triggers: make a skill from a url

steps.purpose: Fetch the page and generate a skill folder
Register, validate and build the generated skill in the hub

gitlab-pipeline-tune.description: Fix a failing or stuck GitLab pipeline, then make it faster and cheaper
triggers: gitlab pipeline broken then speed up

steps.purpose: Find and fix why the pipeline fails or is stuck
Measure and speed up the working pipeline

cv-for-job.description: Tailor a CV to a job post, review it, and draft a cover letter

steps.purpose: Tailor and review the CV against the job post, then draft the cover letter

pdf-to-skills.description: Generate skills from a PDF book or manual and add them to the hub

steps.purpose: Split the PDF and generate skill folders
Register and validate the generated skills
